description: SharePoint columns (listItem fields) of Ricardo's Quality AO packets (QCQA library Documents, /AOs/2026 - AOs; the ao-originals drive in evals/dev/cases/ao_originals_expected.json) read through the GET-only Graph adapter (integrations/graph_read.py SharePointReader.list_item_fields: drive gate, metadata GET, audience and ACL, then GET /drives/{drive}/items/{item}/listItem?expand=fields, eTag re-read). Only the Portal-taxonomy columns (operating/doc_metadata.py CURRENT_COLUMN_FIELDS) are kept. Output: counts, allowlisted column names seen and booleans only (no field values, file names, library names, ids or URLs); taxonomy_columns_by_library_class gives, under the library's security class (operating/doc_metadata_taxonomy.py known_library_class of its display name, one GET /drives/{drive}; STANDARD when the name names no restricted class, UNRESOLVED when it cannot be read), the files and listItems read and how many carry each Portal-taxonomy column (0: empty or not provisioned). Needs MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TENANT_ID, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID and MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET. Read-only: GET only, token POST only. The Portal's own document library (SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID) is read by its own check, verify/live-checks/graph.sharepoint_library_columns.json, so this AO evidence does not go red when only that library read fails.
notes: field_names_present may legitimately be empty: Graph omits empty columns from listItem.fields, so an absent column means empty or not provisioned. The folder holds the six AO packets; files_listed counts every file in it (cap 20). ctag_matches_listing proves the content tag the playbook evaluator binds a document-type column to (operating/playbook_originals.py: a column edit moves the eTag, not the cTag) is returned on the listItem path; document_kind_readings counts how each DocumentCategory/DocumentType/ContentType value reads for a playbook kind (<column>:<reading>), never the value.
